description: The plot illustrates WikiText validation perplexity as a function of the pruning parameter \(M\) for three models (LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B). The x-axis is labeled “M” on a linear scale with integer ticks from 3 to 8 at an interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled “Perplexity” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 20 to 40 with labeled ticks at 20.0, 30.0, and 40.0. Three lines are shown: LLaMA1-7B is a green solid line with circular markers, starting near 28 at \(M=3\), decreasing to about 25 at \(M=4\) and about 24–25 at \(M=5\), then rising to about 27 at \(M=6\), about 31 at \(M=7\), and ending near 36 at \(M=8\). LLaMA1-13B is an orange solid line with star markers, starting near 20 at \(M=3\), dropping to about 16–17 at \(M=4\), about 16 at \(M=5\), about 15–16 at \(M=6\), then increasing to about 17 at \(M=7\) and returning to about 20 at \(M=8\). Vicuna-7B is a blue solid line with upward triangle markers, beginning near 41 at \(M=3\), decreasing to about 35 at \(M=4\), staying around 34–35 at \(M=5\), about 34 at \(M=6\), about 34–35 at \(M=7\), and increasing to about 39–40 at \(M=8\); the legend at the right associates each color/marker with its model name.
caption_used: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The line plot depicts perplexity on the y-axis (linear scale, 20.0 to 40.0) against the parameter M on the x-axis (linear scale, 3 to 8). Vicuna-7B (blue line with triangular markers) demonstrates a sharp decline in perplexity from approximately 41.0 at M=3 to 30.0 at M=4, stabilizing around 33.0 for M=5 to M=7, before rising to 39.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-7B (green line with circular markers) exhibits a gradual decline from 28.0 at M=3 to a minimum of 22.0 at M=5, then escalates to 36.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-13B (orange line with star markers) consistently outperforms the other models, starting at 20.0 at M=3, declining steadily to 15.0 at M=6, and then increasing modestly to 20.0 at M=8. The legend, positioned centrally, clarifies the model-marker associations. Notably, LLaMA1-7B and Vicuna-7B perplexity values converge closely at M=7, with LLaMA1-7B marginally exceeding Vicuna-7B at this point.
